title: Let the test launcher stop a stalled run it started when no supervisor is attached
outcome: Let the test launcher stop a stalled run it started when no supervisor is attached
acceptance: The launcher's supported stop ends a run it started (its own process tree only) even when no supervisor is attached, and records the stop as the run's terminal outcome
A behaviour test starts a run that never finishes and stops it through the supported route without a supervisor
disposal_reason: Duplicate of Windows B's w-33d337c8b9e5, which has the exact scope: the launcher stop must work for a DETACHED FOCUSED run on Windows. Evidence carried over: `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs stop test-eb00a39e-9351-4693-9993-d1626d688e73` returned "FAIL launcher: run has no owned Windows job or POSIX process-group supervisor; legacy and unsupported runs cannot be stopped". scripts/launcher-stop.mjs:123-126 requires stopProtocol and full=true, and detached focused runs get neither. Owner: Engram::Codex-WinB-Coder3, after w-b07e55238659.
